details: Project Fantasy. Research And Development. I Explored new ways of doing GPU based simulation of fluids at scale on AAA budgets as well as other physics driven effects. Designed procedural pipeline infrastructure and procedural tools in Houdini and the Glacier Engine
Designed a cloud-based routing solution using Bayesian travel-time inference methods used by Denmark’s largest mobile-car-washing provider.
Studied deep-learning-based physics simulation for glacial isostatic adjustment models.
Mostly on glacial dynamics - Implemented the semi implicit material point method from Frozen in Houdini for my master

projects.title: Viscoelastic Earth Model
projects.description: Glaciel isostatic adjustment is the Earth deformation response to shifting ice mass as ice sheets move on the surface. I Developed a fully custom finite element solver In Houdini HDK cabable of solving the deformation taking into account the material properties ice sheet development since the last ice age.
